svg.title: meshack musyoka — CTO at Ziya, software engineer, nairobi, kenya
svg.desc: A terminal session. whoami: meshack musyoka, software engineer in Nairobi, Kenya, CTO at Ziya. ls ~/shipped: voice/ encrypted incident logging for GBV survivors. private by design; easydaraja/ complete daraja dev toolkit — SDK, CLI, MCP, callbacks, docs; docmtaani/ telemedicine for kenya. a doctor in your pocket; creda/ AI equity research that cites its sources or says nothing; +11 more/ the work tab keeps scrolling. bring a snack. Then a night skyline with one building for each week of the past year, taller for busier weeks: 1,830 contributions in all.
